_source: Training feedback reports (PIF): District_Training_Feedback_Report.docx, District_Constituency Training Feedback.docx, Master Training_Feedback_Analysis.docx. Nine statements rated 1 to 5. Figures transcribed as printed; nothing recomputed. The constituency file heads its pages "DISTRICT TRAINING FEEDBACK REPORT" and its Q2 still reads "as a district official"; it is treated as constituency-level because its response counts match the constituency round in assessment_results.json, not the district round. Where a row's shares do not sum to 100%, sum_flag carries the printed total.

questions.text: The objectives of the training session were clearly explained.
The training content was relevant to my role as a district official.
The session helped me understand the importance of GVA/GDDP in district planning.
The trainer explained the concepts in a clear and simple manner.
The examples and case studies used in the session were useful and practical.
The training helped me identify sector-specific opportunities for improving district GVA.
The training encouraged active participation and discussion among participants.
The duration and pace of the training session were appropriate.
Overall, the training was useful for improving my understanding of district economic growth and planning.
